wiki.title: Sarah Elfreth
wiki.extract: Sarah Kelly Elfreth (, ELF-rəth; born September 9, 1988) is an American politician who is serving as the U.S. representative for Maryland's 3rd congressional district since 2025. A member of the Democratic Party, she represented the 30th district in the Maryland Senate from 2019 to 2025.
